executiveSummary: Friday was a narrow technology-led Nikkei rally, while Saturday's U.S. strikes on three Iranian crude carriers materially increased weekend geopolitical and oil risk after Japanese PTS had already closed. Monday's Friday-night Nikkei futures premium is therefore stale and should not be treated as a clean bullish signal. Semiconductor/AI momentum remains strong, but energy/defense and banks deserve higher priority than in the prior committee because of weekend escalation and BOJ tightening expectations.
